inspect-antenna.title: Inspect the antenna site
inspect-antenna.prompt: Mark each item safe or a hazard.

config.scene: Antenna day at a club member's house.

items.label: Antenna and rotator cables are grounded whenever the station is off.
items.why: It helps protect the station and building from lightning.

items.label: The lightning surge protector is fitted behind the transceiver.
items.why: It belongs outside, close to the earth ground, so the surge doesn't enter the house.

items.label: The climber wears approved fall arrest equipment.
items.why: It limits injuries if they fall.

items.label: The helper at the base of the tower has no hard hat.
items.why: A dropped tool could hit them.

items.label: A wire antenna is strung at head height across the yard.
items.why: Someone could touch it while you transmit and get an RF burn.

items.label: The transmitter is off and the feedline disconnected before repairs start.
Open-wire feedline runs along the fence beside the footpath.
items.why: High RF voltage on it can burn anyone who touches it.
